adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `uniqueGuests` is computed via `guests.filter(...)` only against existing `booking.attendees` and a blacklist, but it does not dedupe duplicates within the incoming `guests` array itself, and it compares emails with strict equality (`guest === attendee.email`) without normalizing case. Since the server input schema (`ZAddGuestsInputSchema`) also does not enforce uniqueness, a request like `["a@x.com","a@x.com"]` (or casing variants vs stored emails) can lead to `createMany` inserting duplicate attendee rows for the same booking.
